content: MCP stdio transport: never write non-JSON-RPC data to stdout (breaks protocol stream) -- log to stderr only. 'spawn ENOENT' usually means the launched command isn't on the client's PATH, not an MCP protocol bug. SSE is deprecated in favor of Streamable HTTP for new remote servers; SSE needs ~30s keep-alives or reverse proxies/idle timeouts kill the connection. Default RPC tool-call timeout is ~60s.
